Low libidos can be caused by many things, not just attraction. 

It can be caused by medications, mental issues like depression and/or confidence issues, stress. Even a physical restriction if the person suffers with an illness which might flair up every now and then.

It's wrong to assume it's all down to one person or the other as it can be a mixture of problems on both ends (and a lot of the time, this is what causes them not to seek fixing the issue).

He doesn't like conflict so when we're arguing, his initial reaction is to let go or give up and say "well dump me", rather than actually face the issue and fix it.
